voice.name: Open Sector - Borg Swarm
voice.note: Shares the Borg Swarm voice designed for the Leech (voices/leech.json); quicker for the fighter.
voice.description: A fast, hissing swarm chorus of many small synthetic voices speaking the same words together, like a hive of insect-like machines piloting alien craft: thin and sharp, raspy and buzzing, with dry clicking and a faint wet chitter between words, emotionless and eager, quick clipped cadence, a slightly metallic hollow resonance under the voice.

fire.prompt: Sci-fi fighter firing twin pulse cannons: two quick bursts of sharp electric energy bolts, rapid laser blaster zaps with crackling sizzle, energy weapon, no gunpowder, no bullets, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Insect-like alien fighter craft flying past overhead: a high-pitched fast insect wing buzz rising and falling as it passes by left to right, a thin electric whine, outdoors, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Insect-like alien fighter shot down: a sharp energy explosion in the air with crackling electric arcs, the wing buzz sputtering and spiralling down in pitch, a crash and burst on the ground, medium distance outdoors, no music, no voice
